      Restore Al-Andalus

      Please help with verifying or updating this infobox. It was last verified for version 1.33.

      Once all of Iberia was ruled by the glorious Muslim rulers of Andalusia. Let us undo the shameful Christian Reconquista and retake the lands of our ancestors.

       
      Potential requirements

      The country:

      • was never an end-game nation.
      • is not Spain, Andalusia, the Papal State, the Holy Roman Empire or the Roman Empire.
      • has not yet enacted this decision.
      • is not a colonial nation.
      • is in the Maghrebi culture group or has Andalusian as primary culture.
      • is Muslim.

      If the country is AI-controlled then it:

      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not a custom nation
      • is not a former colonial nation.
      • has at least 6 cities and must own at least 1 province in Upper or Lower Andalucia.

      Playing with normal or historical nations.

      		Allow

      Andalusia does not exist.
      The country:

      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not at war.
      • is not a nomad nation.
      • has not a tribal government.
      • owns its core provinces:
        • Murcia (221)
        • Almería (222)
        • Granada (223)
        • Sevilla (224)
        • Córdoba (225)
        • Gibraltar (226)
        • Jaén (1748)
        • Cadiz (1749)
        • Albacete (4547)
        • Huelva (4548)
        • Either:
          • Beja (229) and Algarve (230)
        • Or:
          • Alicante (1750) and Xàtiva (4549)
      • Córdoba (225) is part of a state
      Effects

      The country:

      • becomes Andalusia.
      • gains 25 prestige.
      • gets new missions.
      • gets the event ‘New Traditions & Ambitions’, unless it is a custom nation.
      • changes primary culture to Andalusian, if not already.
      • becomes a Monarchy if they arent one and arent Revolutionary
      • enacts the Al-Andalusian Sultanate government reform if they arent Revolutionary
      • increases rank to kingdom, if it is a duchy
      • removes all provinces from the Holy Roman Empire, if it is a member and not an elector or the emperor.
      • gets a permanent claim on all unowned provinces of:
        • Toledo area
        • Upper Andalucia area
        • Lower Andalucia area
        • Badajoz (218)
        • València (220)
        • Alicante (1750)
        • Caceres (1747)
      • gets “Increased Centralization” for 10 years, giving:
        • −0.05 monthly autonomy change,
        • +1 national unrest.

      If Córdoba (225) is part of the HRE, but its owner is not a member then:

      • the province is removed from the HRE.
      • the Holy Roman Emperor:
        • gets the opinion modifier “Removed provinces from the Empire” towards the owner, worth −50 opinion with a yearly decay of 1.
        • loses 1 imperial authority.

      Córdoba (225):

      • becomes the new capital of the owner country.

      If the 'Golden Century' DLC is active:

      • (Hidden) if was formed by Morocco:
        • completes the missions Rout the Pretenders! and Moroccan Ties without rewards.
      • If the mission Liberate Qurtuba is completed:
        • gets a permanent claim on all provinces in Alentejo and Beira areas
      • If the mission Seize Trade Dominance is completed:
        • gets a permanent claim on all provinces in Tyrrhenian Isles and Baleares areas
      • If the mission Restore Faith in the Throne is completed:
        • gets a permanent claim on all provinces in Algiers, High Plains, Barbary Coast, Kabylia, Tunisia, Djerba, Central Morocco, Gharb, North Morocco and Tripolitania areas
      AI will always take this decision

      Form British Nation

      Please help with verifying or updating this infobox. It was last verified for version 1.33.

      By uniting our political development domestically and extending our influence beyond our borders we will be able to reinforce our position in world affairs and transform into one of the foremost European powers, the British Empire.

       
      Potential requirements

      Great Britain does not exist.
      The country:

      • was never an end-game nation.
      • is not the Papal State or the Holy Roman Empire or the Angevin Kingdom.
      • has not decided for the Angevin mission path
      • has not yet enacted this decision.
      • is in the British culture group or has Highlander as primary culture.
      • is not a colonial nation.
      • Does not have the "English Parliament"

      If the country is AI-controlled then it:

      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not a custom nation
      • is not a former colonial nation.
      • has at least 3 cities

      Playing with normal or historical nations.

      		Allow

      The country:

      • has an administrative technology of at least level 10.
      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not at war.
      • is not a nomad nation.
      • owns its core provinces:
        • London (236).
        • Oxford (237).
        • Hampshire (234).
        • Lothian (248).
        • Aberdeen (251).
      • London (236) is part of a state
      Effects

      The country:

      • becomes Great Britain.
      • restore its name
      • gains 25 prestige.
      • gets new missions.
      • gets the event ‘New Traditions & Ambitions’, unless it is a custom nation.
      • increases rank to kingdom, if it is a duchy
      • removes all provinces from the Holy Roman Empire, if it is a member and not an elector or the emperor.
      • gets a permanent claim on Britain region.
      • (Hidden) completes the mission War of the Roses without rewards.
      • gets “Increased Centralization” for 20 years, giving:
        • −0.05 monthly autonomy change,
        • +1 national unrest.

      If London (236) is part of the HRE, but its owner is not a member then:

      • the province is removed from the HRE.
      • the Holy Roman Emperor:
        • gets the opinion modifier “Removed provinces from the Empire” towards the owner, worth −50 opinion with a yearly decay of 1.
        • loses 1 imperial authority.

      London (236):

      • becomes the new capital of the owner country.

      If Great Britain:

      • (Hidden) was formed by Scotland
        • completes the missions Levy the Troops and Conquer Scotland without rewards.
      • (Hidden) was formed by Ireland
        • completes the missions Levy the Troops, Conquer Scotland and Conquer Ireland without rewards.
      • has completed the mission Conquer Scotland and the ‘Rule Britannia’ DLC is enabled
        • gets permanent claims on Orkney (369), Shetland (1978) and Färöarna (1979)
        • gets claims on all provinces of the Iceland area.
      • has completed the mission Colonize Spice Islands and the ‘Rule Britannia’ DLC is enabled
        • gets claims on all provinces of West Bengal.
      • AI will always take this decision
      • AI gives "high priority" (400) to this decision
      • AI Scotland will not pursue this decision of they dont see England as a Enemy


      id

      Form British Nation Diplomatically

      Please help with verifying or updating this infobox. It was last verified for version 1.33.

      By uniting our political development domestically and extending our influence beyond our borders we will be able to reinforce our position in world affairs and transform into one of the foremost European powers, the British Empire.

       
      Potential requirements

      Great Britain does not exist.
      The country:

      • was never an end-game nation.
      • is either England or Scotland.
      • is not the Angevin Kingdom.
      • has not decided for the Angevin mission path
      • Does not have the "English Parliament"

      If the country is AI-controlled then it:

      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not a custom nation.

      Playing with normal or historical nations.

      		Allow

      The country:

      • has an administrative technology of at least level 10.
      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not at war.
      • is not a nomad nation.
      • has 100 legitimacy.

      If the country is England, then Scotland:

      • is a vassal of or in a personal union under England.
      • has less than 15 cities.

      If the country is Scotland, then England:

      • is a vassal of or in a personal union under Scotland.
      • has less than 41 cities.
      Effects

      The country:

      • becomes Great Britain.
      • restore its name
      • inherits Scotland or England, as appropriate.
      • gains 25 prestige.
      • gets new missions.
      • gets the event ‘New Traditions & Ambitions’, unless it is a custom nation.
      • increases rank to kingdom, if it is a duchy
      • removes all provinces from the Holy Roman Empire, if it is a member and not an elector or the emperor.
      • gets a permanent claim on Britain region.
      • (Hidden) completes the missions Levy the Troops, Conquer Scotland and War of the Roses without rewards.
      • gets “Increased Centralization” for 20 years, giving:
        • −0.05 monthly autonomy change,
        • +1 national unrest.
      • AI will always take this decision
      • AI gives "high priority" (200) to this decision


      id

      Form English Nation

      Trade has long been a foundation of English national policy. By extending our influence across borders and controlling its political development domestically, we have managed to become one of the foremost European powers. Our colonial expansion is becoming a major factor in promoting our nation's economic growth, reinforcing our position in world affairs.
       
      Potential requirements

      Great Britain does not exist.
      The country:

      • was never an end-game nation.
      • is not the Holy Roman Empire, the Papal States, the Angevin Kingdom or England.
      • has not yet enacted this decision.
      • is not a colonial nation.
      • has English as primary culture or is Mann.

      If the country is AI-controlled then it:

      • is not a custom nation
      • is not a former colonial nation.

      Playing with normal or historical nations.

      		Allow

      England does not exist.
      The country:

      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not at war.
      • is not a nomad nation.
      • owns its core provinces:
        • London (236)
        • Oxford (237)
        • Hampshire (234)
        • Kent (235)
        • Essex (238).
      • London (236) is part of a state
      Effects

      The country:

      • becomes England.
      • restore its name and color
      • gains 25 prestige.
      • gets new missions.
      • gets the event ‘New Traditions & Ambitions’, unless it is a custom nation.
      • increases rank to kingdom, if it is a duchy
      • becomes a Monarchy if their government type is not locked
      • enacts the English Monarchy government reform if it is a Monarchy and it does not have one of the excluded locked first tier reforms[1]
      • removes all provinces from the Holy Roman Empire, if it is a member and not an elector or the emperor.
      • gets permanent claims on all unowned provinces of:
        • London (area)
        • Yorkshire area
        • East Midlands area
        • West Midlands area
        • East Anglia area
        • Wales (area)
        • Wessex area
        • Northumberland (246)
        • Cumbria (247).
      • gets “Increased Centralization” for 20 years, giving:
        • −0.05 monthly autonomy change,
        • +1 national unrest.

      If London (236) is part of the HRE, but its owner is not a member then:

      • the province is removed from the HRE.
      • the Holy Roman Emperor:
        • gets the opinion modifier “Removed provinces from the Empire” towards the owner, worth −50 opinion with a yearly decay of 1.
        • loses 1 imperial authority.

      London (236):

      • becomes the new capital of the owner country.
      • AI will always take this decision
      • AI gives "high priority" (400) to this decision

      Form French Nation

      Please help with verifying or updating this infobox. It was last verified for version 1.33.

      This year will mark the beginning of an evolutionary period for our nation. The old feudal ways will begin to make way for a more modern centralized nation. Although struggling financially due to miscalculated projects and military campaigns, we have managed to transform ourselves into one of the most dominant powers of Europe.

       
      Potential requirements

      The country:

      • was never an end-game nation.
      • is not the Holy Roman Empire, France, the Papal States, the Angevin Kingdom or Spain.
      • has not yet enacted this decision.
      • is not a colonial nation.
      • is in the French culture group or has Basque or Breton as primary culture.

      If the country is AI-controlled then it:

      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not a custom nation
      • is not a former colonial nation.

      Playing with normal or historical nations.

      		Allow

      France does not exist.
      The country:

      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not at war.
      • is not a nomad nation.
      • owns its core provinces:
        • Paris (183)
        • Orleanais (184)
        • Champagne (186).
      • owns at least 15 core provinces in France region.
      • Paris (183) is part of a state.
      Effects

      The country:

      • becomes France.
      • restore its name
      • gains 25 prestige.
      • gets new missions.
      • gets the event ‘New Traditions & Ambitions’, unless it is a custom nation.
      • increases rank to kingdom, if it is a duchy
      • removes all provinces from the Holy Roman Empire, if it is a member and not an elector or the emperor.

      • the province is removed from the HRE.
      • the Holy Roman Emperor:
        • gets the opinion modifier “Removed provinces from the Empire” towards the owner, worth −50 opinion with a yearly decay of 1.
        • loses 1 imperial authority.

      Paris (183):

      • becomes the new capital of the owner country.
      AI will always take this decision

      Embrace Icelandic Identity

      Please help with verifying or updating this infobox. It was last verified for version 1.33.

      Circumstances have conspired to make our Icelandic holdings the foremost part of our country. Let us embrace this new identity as an Icelandic country and strengthen the local institutions, entrenching our own rule over the island.

       
      Potential requirements

      Iceland does not exist.
      The country:

      • was never an end-game nation.
      • is not the Holy Roman Empire, Roman Empire, the Papal States, the Ottomans or Byzantium.
      • has not yet enacted this decision.
      • is not a colonial nation.
      • owns Reykjavik (370) and Akureyri (371).

      If the country is AI-controlled then it:

      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not a custom nation
      • is not a former colonial nation.
      • has fewer than 4 cities.

      Playing with normal or historical nations.

      		Allow

      The country:

      • is not at war.
      • owns fewer than 4 cities.
      • owns core provinces:
        • Reykjavik (370)
        • Akureyri (371)
      • Reykjavik (370) is part of a state.
      Effects

      The country:

      • becomes Iceland.
      • gets the event ‘New Traditions & Ambitions’, unless it is a custom nation.
      • changes its primary culture to that of the capital, unless the country's culture is Norwegian.

      Reykjavik and Akureyri both:

      • lose 100 local autonomy.
      • gain 1 base tax.
      • gain 1 base production.

      If the country's capital is not in Iceland area, then:

      • If Reykjavik (370) is part of the HRE, but its owner is not a member then:
      • the province is removed from the HRE.
      • the Holy Roman Emperor:
        • gets the opinion modifier “Removed provinces from the Empire” towards the owner, worth −50 opinion with a yearly decay of 1.
        • loses 1 imperial authority.

      Reykjavik (370):

      • becomes the new capital of the owner country.
      (Hidden) If the forming country is Norway, Denmark or Sweden:
      • All cores on unowned provinces are preserved for the country's old identity instead of becoming cores of Iceland.
      Otherwise it loses those cores.
      AI will always take this decision unless its capital is not in Reykjavik or Akureyri

      Form Irish Nation

      Please help with verifying or updating this infobox. It was last verified for version 1.33.

      For decades England has attempted to subjugate the Irish population and take control of the island. To unite the Irish lands under a sole flag may be our only chance to repel them.

       
      Potential requirements

      Ireland does not exist.
      The country:

      • was never an end-game nation.
      • is not the Papal State or the Holy Roman Empire.
      • has not yet enacted this decision.
      • is not a colonial nation.
      • has Irish as primary culture.

      If the country is AI-controlled then it:

      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not a custom nation
      • is not a former colonial nation.
      • has at least 3 cities.

      Playing with normal or historical nations.

      		Allow

      The country:

      • has an administrative technology of at least level 10.
      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not at war.
      • is not a nomad nation.
      • owns all provinces in the following areas:
        • Munster
        • Connacht
        • Leinster
        • Ulster.
      Effects

      The country:

      • becomes Ireland.
      • gains 10 prestige.
      • gets new missions.
      • gets the event ‘New Traditions & Ambitions’, unless it is a custom nation.
      • increases rank to kingdom, if it is a duchy
      • unlocks the Irish High Kingdom government reform if Domination is active
      • enacts the Irish High Kingdom government reform if the Tanistry reform is enacted
      • removes all provinces from the Holy Roman Empire, if it is a member and not an elector or the emperor.
      • gets “Increased Centralization” for 20 years, giving:
        • −0.05 monthly autonomy change,
        • +1 national unrest.
      • AI will always take this decision
      • AI gives "high priority" (400) to this decision

      Form Dutch Nation

      Please help with verifying or updating this infobox. It was last verified for version 1.33.

      The Dutch are emerging as one of Europe's most capable naval and colonial powers. Lucrative trade opportunities, locally and overseas, have resulted in a swift evolution for the country into one of the first capitalist countries in the world.

       
      Potential requirements

      The country:

      • was never an end-game nation.
      • is not the Papal States, Netherlands or the Holy Roman Empire.
      • has not yet enacted this decision.
      • has Dutch, Flemish or Frisian as primary culture or is Burgundy

      If the country is AI-controlled then it:

      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not a custom nation
      • the Netherlands do not exist

      Playing with normal or historical nations.

      		Allow

      The Netherlands do not exist
      The country:

      • has an administrative technology of at least level 10.
      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not at war.
      • is not a nomad nation.
      • owns its core provinces:
        • Breda (95)
        • Amsterdam (97)
        • Utrecht (98)
        • Gelre (99)
        • Den Haag (4383)
      • owns at least 10 core provinces in Low Countries region.
      • Amsterdam (97) is part of a state.
      • if is Burgundy, does not currently have the Dutch Revolt disaster.
      Effects

      The country:

      • becomes the Netherlands.
      • restore its name
      • gains 25 prestige.
      • gets new missions.
      • gets the event ‘New Traditions & Ambitions’, unless it is a custom nation or already uses Dutch ideas
      • increases rank to kingdom, if it is a duchy
      • removes all provinces from the Holy Roman Empire, if it is a member and not an elector or the emperor.
      • gets a permanent claim on Low Countries region except East Frisia (1931)
      • If is Burgundy:
        • changes primary culture to Dutch
        • moves capital to Amsterdam (97)
        • If France exists:
          • All provinces in France region owned by Burgundy or their subject:
            • owner and Burgundy loses the core
            • France gains a core
            • Cede province to France
      • AI will always take this decision
      • AI gives "high priority" (400) to this decision, unless its allies own any of the required provinces
      • AI will not pursue this decision if it is Burgundy before 1500
      • AI will not pursue this decision if it doesnt have adm tech 9
      • AI will not pursue this decision if it has less than 3 provinces

      Form Scottish Nation

      Please help with verifying or updating this infobox. It was last verified for version 1.33.

      The once proud nation of Scotland has fallen into ruin, yet there remain some among the Clans with the will to restore our kingdom. We will muster our courage and fight for a free and independent Scotland.

       
      Potential requirements

      The country:

      Please help with verifying or updating this infobox. It was last verified for version 1.33.

      Dai Viet has been torn apart by feuding noble houses. We must unite the Vietnamese people and restore our kingdom.

       
      Potential requirements

      The country:

      • was never an end-game nation.
      • is not Dai Viet, Holy Roman Empire or The Papal State
      • has not yet enacted this decision.
      • is not a colonial nation.
      • has Vietnamese or Sino-Vietnamese as primary culture.

      If the country is AI-controlled then it:

      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not a custom nation
      • is not a former colonial nation.
      • Dai Viet does not exist
      • has at least 3 cities

      Playing with normal or historical nations

      		Allow

      Dai Viet does not exist.
      The country:

      • is Tonkin or Tonkin does not exist
      • is Annam or Annam does not exist
      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not at war
      • is not a nomad nation
      • owns its core provinces of:
        • Annam area
        • Sông Hông area
      Effects

      The country:

      • becomes Dai Viet
      • gains 25 prestige.
      • gets new missions
      • gets the event ‘New Traditions & Ambitions’, unless it is a custom nation.
      • increases rank to kingdom, if it is a duchy
      • removes all provinces from the Holy Roman Empire, if it is a member and not an elector or the emperor.
      • gets “Increased Centralization” for 20 years, giving:
        • −0.05 monthly autonomy change,
        • +1 national unrest.

      • AI will always take this decision.
      • AI gives "high priority" (400) to this decision

      Unite Japan!

      Please help with verifying or updating this infobox. It was last verified for version 1.33.

      The time has come to unite Japan by force! The time for diplomacy is over and all these warring daimyo lords must be conquered.

       
      Potential requirements

      The country:

      • was never an end-game nation.
      • has enacted the ‘Shogunate’ government reform.
      • has at least 1 subject daimyo.
      		 Allow

      Japan does not exist.
      The country:

      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not at war.
      • is not a nomad nation.
      • owns at least 25 cities.
      • owns Kyoto (1020) and Musashi (1028).
      Effects

      The country:

      • becomes Japan.
      • gets new missions.
      • gets the event ‘New Traditions & Ambitions’, unless it is a custom nation.
      • becomes an empire.
      • abolishes the ‘Shogunate’ government reform.
      • loses its cores on every provinces owned by the subject daimyos of the country.
      • gains a permanent claim on over province in the Japan region, not owned by themselfes or their subjects
      • if Domination is active :
        • Gain country modifier “New Era Samurai” for the rest of the game, giving the following effects:
          • Country allows samurai infantry
          • +10% Samurai force limit

      All subject daimyos of the country:

      • become independent.
      • abolish the ‘Daimyo’ government reform.
      The AI will not take this decision with less than 30 cities.

      Adopt Manchu Identity

      Please help with verifying or updating this infobox. It was last verified for version 1.33.

      With the three capitals of the ancient Jurchen tribes firmly in our hands, it is now time to proclaim our people's unification through the adoption of a new identity: Manchu.

       
      Potential requirements

      Manchu does not exist.
      The country:

      • was never an end-game tag.
      • has not yet enacted this decision.
      • has Jurchen or Manchu as primary culture.

      If the country is AI-controlled, then it:

      • AI gives "high priority" (400) to this decision
      • is not a custom nation

      Playing with normal or historical nations.

      		Allow

      The country:

      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not at war.
      • owns its core provinces:
        • Girin (730)
        • Huncun (2108).
      • owns at least 20 core provinces with Jurchen or Manchu culture.
      • Girin (730) is part of a state
      Effects

      The country:

      • becomes Manchu.
      • gains 25 prestige.
      • gets new missions.
      • increases rank to kingdom, if it is a duchy
      • gets the event ‘New Traditions & Ambitions’, unless it is a custom nation or has Manchurian ideas
      • changes primary culture to Manchu.
      • changes ruler culture to Manchu.
      • if the country has an heir:
        • changes heir culture to Manchu.
      • if the country has a consort of Jurchen culture:
        • changes consort culture to Manchu.
      • gains cores on all not cored provinces in the Manchuria region.
      • if the country is a subject:
        • the overlord gets the event The Rise of Manchuria.
        • the country gains independence.

      Hidden effects:

      • Every province with Jurchen culture
        • changes province culture to Manchu
      • Every country with Jurchen primary culture
        • changes primary culture to Manchu.
        • changes ruler culture to Manchu.
        • if the country has an heir:
          • changes heir culture to Manchu.
        • if the country has a consort of Jurchen culture:
          • changes consort culture to Manchu.
      • if Korea exists, is a subject nation but not ours
        • Korea gets the event ‘[Root.GetName] and the Rise of the Manchu’ in 20 days

      If Girin (730) is part of the HRE, but its owner is not a member then:

      • the province is removed from the HRE.
      • the Holy Roman Emperor:
        • gets the opinion modifier “Removed provinces from the Empire” towards the owner, worth −50 opinion with a yearly decay of 1.
        • loses 1 imperial authority.

      Girin (730):

      • becomes the new capital of the owner country.
      AI gives "very high priority" (5000) to this decision

      • if primary culture is in the French culture group:
        • change primary culture to Québécois.
      • changes to Canada.
      • gains a permanent claim on every non-owned province of Colonial Canada region.
      • gains 25 prestige.
      • gets the modifier “Increased Centralization” for 20 years:
        • −0.05 Monthly autonomy change
        • +1 National unrest

      If the country:

      • is a member of the Holy Roman Empire and not an elector or the emperor
        • then all its provinces are removed from the HRE.
      • is a duchy
        • then it becomes a kingdom.
      • was not a former colonial nation then:
        • it loses all subjects in Europe, Asia, and Africa
        • it inherits all its colonial nations
        • it will not be able to form any colonial nations[17]
        • all its provinces in Europe, Asia, and Africa are ceded to their former nation
      • does not have custom ideas
        • then it gets the ‘New Traditions & Ambitions’ event.
      • has enacted the “Elective Monarchy” government reform
        • then it enacts the government reform “Feudal Nobility”

      Form Cascadia

      Please help with verifying or updating this infobox. It was last verified for version 1.30.

      All along the Columbia river and on the Pacific coast of America, our colonies stand united and independent and it is time we decided a name for our new nation, free from the labels of our colonial overlords. As Cascadia, we will lay claim to all lands north of the Columbia river and create a new nation of trade, freedom, and beauty!

       
      Potential requirements
      • is not playing with random New World.
      • has not enacted a colonial nation formation decision before.
      • is not an end-game tag.
      • is not a nomad nation.
      • Either:
        • is a colonial nation.
        • is a former colonial nation.
        • Capital is in the Colonial Cascadia region.
          • is not in a native American technology group.
      • owns a province in the Colonial Cascadia region.
      		 Allow
      • Cascadia does not exist.
      • Administrative technology is at least 10.
      • is not a subject nation other than a tributary state or a cultural influenced state.
      • is not at war.
      • Capital is in the Colonial Cascadia region.
      • owns at least 10 cities in the Colonial Cascadia region.
      Effects

      • changes to Cascadia.
      • gains a permanent claim on every non-owned province of:
        • Colonial Cascadia region.
      • gains 25 prestige.
      • gets the modifier “Increased Centralization” for 20 years:
        • −0.05 Monthly autonomy change
        • +1 National unrest

      If the country:

      • is a member of the Holy Roman Empire and not an elector or the emperor
        • then all its provinces are removed from the HRE.
      • is a duchy
        • then it becomes a kingdom.
      • was not a former colonial nation then:
        • it loses all subjects in Europe, Asia, and Africa
        • it inherits all its colonial nations
        • it will not be able to form any colonial nations[17]
        • all its provinces in Europe, Asia, and Africa are ceded to their former nation
      • if primary culture is in the Iberian culture group:
